inhomogeneous_deformation.gamma_convention: Deformed graded bracket = undeformed bracket + κ times gamma; gamma coefficients are listed once for each canonical basis pair.
inhomogeneous_deformation.formal_coefficient_convention: gb parameters are retained as formal labels. The source assigns odd parity to both gb and κ, although their product is even while the mixed oscillator bracket is odd; no parity sign is inferred from the formal coefficient.
